```yaml
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js

          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run checks
        run: npm run check

  publish:
    needs: check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Publish npm package
        run: npm publish --access public
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

  publish-gh-pages:
    needs: publish
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Generate GH Pages
        run: ./scripts/generate-gh-pages.sh ${{ github.ref_name }}
```

```bash
#!/bin/bash

set -e

# Function to extract semantic version from tag
extract_semver() {
  echo "$1" | sed -nE 's/^.*([0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+).*/\1/p'
}

# Get the tag name
TAG=$1

# Extract semantic version
SEMVER=$(extract_semver "$TAG")

# Create or update gh-pages branch
git checkout --orphan gh-pages
git rm -rf .
git add .

# Generate docs
npm run typedoc -- --out docs --entryPoints src --exclude "**/*.test.ts" --exclude "**/mocks/**" --exclude "**/examples/**" --exclude "**/integration-tests/**"

# Move docs to versioned directory
mkdir -p "docs/$SEMVER"
mv docs/* "docs/$SEMVER/"

# Update latest_version.yml
cat <<EOF > docs/_data/latest_version.yml
version: $SEMVER
EOF

# Copy static Jekyll template files for latest version
if [ "$SEMVER" == "$(ls docs | sort -Vr | head -n 1)" ]; then
  cp -r .github/pages/* docs/
fi

# Add changes and commit
git add docs
git commit -m "Update docs for $SEMVER"

# Push changes to gh-pages branch
git push origin gh-pages --force
```
